description.value:
While this feature is active, every necrotic damage roll you make is rolled twice and the higher total is kept. This applies to weapon attacks, spell attacks and saving-throw spells alike, and has no once-per-turn limit.

To cover a different damage type, edit the Active Effect on this item and change the effect value from necrotic to the damage type you want. Several types can be listed at once, separated by commas: necrotic,radiant.

effects.name: Damage Advantage
effects.description: Damage rolls of the listed types are rolled twice, keeping the higher total.
